title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer of 10^{-4} eV must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct formula for spin-orbit coupling energy splitting.

title: Parameter Identification
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and define the parameters n, l, s, j1, and j2.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show clear and logical steps in the calculation leading to the final answer.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of constants.
